ctx.x: Well it came from New Orleans, you know that.

Many did, and many came from here and many came from New York but we won't get into that right now because that's -- but I know Willie "The Lion" Smith remembers hearing music at the turn of the century with his father, his father was a quarry worker, and about the time -- I think I am of the school but I think it was a simultaneous thing.

It didn't really all originate in one little city called New Orleans. I think it popped up in New York and Kansas City and Chicago pretty much at the same time. But anyway, we're at the end of Side Two of TAPE Four of the interview of the great Samuel Baby Lovett, being interviewed by Art Smith and Charles Crook Goodwin and we will now, I think, end this tape and go on to Tape Five. We'll be right back, ladies and gentlemen.
